text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and avoid too much sugar. Second, exercise regularly—even a short walk every day makes a difference. Third, make sure you get enough sleep, because good rest helps your body recover and your brain work well. Mental health is just as important, so take time to relax and talk to friends when you feel stressed. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance. Don't spend all your time working; leave space for hobbies and family. Small daily habits like these can make you healthier and happier in the long run.
